state.goal: Choose the deployment approach for a small team's web service
state.question: Should the service run on a managed platform or a self-managed server?
known_constraints: monthly spend must stay within the approved budget
evidence: a managed platform and a self-managed server both fit the budget
one team member can maintain a server

alternatives.name: Managed container platform
alternatives.description: Deploy the container to a managed platform and let it handle operations.

alternatives.name: Self-managed virtual server
alternatives.description: Run the container on a virtual server the team maintains itself.
